rationale: Z has the most distinctive identity: a terracotta and forest palette, an italic serif accent, a wren illustration, and a layered lab and schedule card. X has a striking lab-slider hero and rich feature visuals, but its social-proof strip wraps awkwardly and its hero cards and spacing feel a little uneven. Y is clean and competent but follows the familiar SaaS pattern of icon cards, three steps and a stats band, so it is the most template-like.
